name: ELVA - Premium Apartment Hotel
beschreibung: The ELVA - Premium Apartment Hotel is centrally located in Neustift im Stubaital. The alpine surroundings offer access to the Stubaier Gletscher ski area and numerous hiking trails. The accommodation combines apartment suites with an integrated kitchenette and a breakfast service. The hotel's own wellness area includes a Finnish sauna and a steam bath. The architecture and furnishings are modern and clean-lined, which shapes the calm atmosphere. The concept is aimed at couples and families who value independence and comfort. The central location allows short distances to nature and local infrastructure.
